plugin.name: Play_Random_Sound
plugin.author: Nick Gammon
plugin.purpose: Plays a sound from a group of sounds
plugin.description:
Implements an interface for other plugins, or triggers etc. to play a sound chosen at random.
Examples of use:
-- loop a battle sound in buffer 9 at -6 db check (CallPlugin ("461479af5d149307e69e305f", "PlayRandomSound", "9,battle,y,-6"))
-- play a single dagger sound in first free buffer at full volume check (CallPlugin ("461479af5d149307e69e305f", "PlayRandomSound", "0,dagger,n,0"))

muclient.script:
sounds = {}
-- args are: buffer,folder,loop,level
function PlayRandomSound (args)
-- Novo padrão para capturar pastas com / ou outros caracteres válidos local buffer, folder, loop, level = string.match (args, "(%d+),([^,]+),%s*([y|n]),%s*(%-?%d+)")
if not buffer then error ("Arguments to PlayRandomSound are: buffer,folder,loop(y/n),level, you supplied: " .. args) end -- if
-- Se a pasta ainda não foi carregada if not sounds[folder] then sounds[folder] = {} -- tabela de arquivos de som local t = assert(utils.readdir(GetInfo(74) .. folder .. "/*wav"))
-- Copiar nomes de arquivos válidos (descartando arquivos temporários ou ocultos) for k in pairs(t) do if k:sub(1, 1) ~= "." then table.insert(sounds[folder], k) end end
-- Verificar se encontramos sons assert(#sounds[folder] > 0, "No sounds in folder " .. folder)
-- ColourNote("white", "green", "Found " .. #sounds[folder] .. " sounds in " .. folder .. " folder.") end
-- Escolher um som aleatório local sound = folder .. "/" .. sounds[folder][math.random(#sounds[folder])]
-- Reproduzir o som check(PlaySound(buffer, sound, loop == "y", level))
end -- function PlayRandomSound
math.randomseed(os.time())
